node.statement: Applying lem-stage1-polar-path-admissibility with a,b,k gives all asserted invertibility, polar-path, continuity, endpoint, and scalar-equivariance conclusions, initially with Z_t in calUbar_{a*(q+epsilon_r*q+q^2)}; monotonicity of the defining calUbar radius upgrades this to calUbar_{C_path*(q+epsilon_r*q+q^2)}, so the full conclusion of node 1 follows.
